## Auto-Retry for Rate Limits

**Registry-based:** only workflows in `AUTO_RETRY_REGISTRY` (in the `Prepare & Classify Error` code node) get immediate retry; others go through the normal flow → 8-hour resolver. Current registry: smart-folder2table, any-file2json-converter.

**How:** extract original Config values from the failed execution's runData → wait "retry in Xs" from the error message (default 60s) → re-run the SAME workflow (dynamic workflow_id) with the original config + rate_limit_wait_seconds.

**Resumability:** restarted workflows check the sheet and skip already-processed files.

### If stops here

Set document → your FailedItems spreadsheet,
sheet → `FailedItems`,
match column → `execution_id`

## 🛡️ Runner-proof alert branch

The normal pipeline starts with **Code nodes** (Prepare & Classify Error). When the **task runner is down**, those Code nodes time out (~60s) and this workflow dies BEFORE reaching any Telegram node — so you get total silence.

This IF checks the raw error message for runner/timeout signatures. If matched, it sends a Telegram alert built with **expressions only** (no Code node → runs in n8n's main process → survives a runner outage).

FALSE → normal rich pipeline (unchanged).
